verdict.rationale: AWS documents a public API for programmatic access, shown by the Cost Explorer API Reference (aws-docs-16). Further first-party programmatic control surfaces exist: the CLI offers console-equivalent functionality and script automation (aws-docs-1, aws-docs-42), and CloudFormation and CDK provision resources from code (aws-docs-6, aws-docs-26, aws-docs-27). The OpenAPI probe 404s only mean no spec at those docs paths and do not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: direct API-reference evidence beyond Cost Explorer covering core services, a discoverable machine-readable spec such as OpenAPI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
